resources.string: The Apple session expired. Open OpenFinder to sign in.
No static tag keys imported yet — import one first.
Permission granted — tap the action again.
Bluetooth actions need the nearby-devices and location permissions.
The tag was not heard in 10 s (other Find My devices were). Shake it and retry.
Nothing heard — shake the tag, keep it within a meter, retry.
Heard it but could not connect — retry once.
Heard and connected, but the tag rejected the ring command.
No answer — bring the tag within a meter and retry.
Battery: %1$s. Vendor indicator; this is not an exact percentage. Recent nearby readings:
⚠ Frames accepted, fresh key not heard back yet — re-check with a scan before rotating again.
Not loud enough (other Find My devices were around). Hold the tag within a meter.
⚠ Tag rejected the %1$s step — rotation not applied.
Writes a new key to the nearby tag (it beeps once) and removes the old key. This manages a nearby tag; it cannot remotely recover a lost tag.
No key check: writes our fresh key to the closest Find My-shaped tag (it beeps). Use only when a foreign write took the tag over — otherwise rotate instead.
Battery unknown · read with the tag nearby
Could not read or save battery history. Please retry.
Location history could not be saved or restored. Retry to keep it across restarts.

Encrypted location history: up to 90 days or 10,000 sightings per tag; the last known location is kept. Signing out clears it. Background queries run about every 30 minutes; power saving may delay them. Updates depend on sightings by nearby Apple devices.
